headlines: AUDUSD: a bearish daily CRT — swept yesterday's high, closed back inside

markets.name: AUDUSD
markets.story: AUDUSD rose 0.11% on a 31 pips range (71% of its 20-day average). The Asian low went first, at 03:07 New York in London, and the high followed at 06:45. Both yesterday's high and low were taken. It swept yesterday's high and closed back inside — a bearish daily CRT. The busiest hour was 06:00 New York (13 pips).
